notes: Real Playwright MCP; no submissions or fixture mutations. 720x500 emulates 200% effective CSS layout, not physical browser zoom.
Raw unnamed DOM count includes hidden/non-operable STDF elements; Playwright accessible role button query found zero unnamed controls in all12 conditions.

All12 screenshots were actually read; no browser JS errors and no POST. Previously saved October date is outside the unchanged current-through-six-month calendar range, so modified settings are discarded through the existing confirmation.
Month title text uses the existing opaque muted token. Valid date cells keep the native STDF selection handler and expose aria-pressed; blank cells are disabled and aria-hidden.
The7 native month grids retain normal native button tab order; this is not an ARIA grid or arrow-key date-picker rewrite.
